ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan -> inflate fee accumulators -> collect inflated fees
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee accumulators (feeGrowthGlobal) are Q128.128 per-unit-liquidity updated only during actual swaps with real token flow. Flash loans provide capital but fees are proportional to real swap activity. No path to inflate fee accumulators without proportional token deposits. _getTokensOwed at DynamicHelper.sol:579 uses mulDiv(delta * liquidity / Q128) which truncates — LP fees are always <= actual fees collected.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - structural argument: fee inflation requires real swap volume, and fee growth is per-unit-liquidity making flash-loan amplification impossible

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Rounding asymmetry in add vs remove liquidity paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Standard Uniswap V3 rounding: addLiquidity rounds UP via getAmount0Delta(roundUp=true) at SqrtPriceMath.sol:200, removeLiquidity rounds DOWN via getAmount0Delta(roundUp=false) at SqrtPriceMath.sol:199. Pool always keeps the dust. Fixed pool type uses calculateFixedSwapByRatioRoundingDown (mulDiv floor) for output and mulDivRoundingUp for input. Single provider similarly correct.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - code inspection of SqrtPriceMath.sol:192-226 confirms rounding directions match Uniswap V3 safety invariants

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan cross-token fee denomination mismatch
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Traced Value Lifecycle (Lens 1): _storeHookFees(loanToken, feeToken, ...) at AMMModule.sol:3375 uses correct token pair as storage key. _storeProtocolFees(feeToken, feeAmount) at L3378 stores on correct feeToken. Surplus handling at L3341/3365 adds to feeAmount which is denominated in feeToken. No denomination mismatch found.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - value tracing through _flashLoan L3288-3382 confirms denomination consistency at all handoffs

ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: At AMMModule.sol:3190, _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) clears all reentrancy guards before hook fee transfers. During safeTransfer to recipients, ERC-777 tokens could allow reentry. However: (1) queue is cleared at L3189 before loop, (2) storage-level underflow checks at L3129 prevent double-spend of hook fees, (3) any slot collision from reentrant swap's queued fees would cause underflow revert in outer loop. Additionally requires ERC-777 or similar callback token AND hook fee queuing — Tier B at best.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - structural argument: storage underflow protection at _transferHookFeesByHook prevents double-spend regardless of reentrancy

ruled_out_vectors.vector: tokensOwed desync between position and pool fee accounting
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Position fees are calculated via _getTokensOwed (DynamicHelper.sol:579) using mulDiv(feeGrowthDelta * liquidity / Q128) which floors. Pool feeBalance is the gross LP fees tracked. feeBalance decremented by collected amount at AMMModule.sol:343-346. The truncation means sum(position_fees) <= feeBalance always holds. Dust stays in pool, favoring solvency.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - mathematical argument: floor(sum) <= sum(floor) = feeBalance

ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: At DynamicHelper.sol:404, feeGrowthGlobal only updates when liquidity > 0. At zero liquidity, swap steps produce amountIn=0 and amountOut=0 (price moves to limit without consuming tokens). Fees computed as step.feeAmount for zero-amountIn steps are also 0. No fees accumulate, no overflow possible.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - code path at SwapMath.sol:53-54 shows amountRemainingLessFee=0 when amountRemaining=0, making amountIn=0 at zero-liquidity ticks

ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All rounding favors protocol: swap output rounds DOWN (SqrtPriceMath.sol:76-77 roundUp=false), swap input rounds UP, fees round UP. Each tiny swap loses the attacker 1+ wei. 100 swaps = 100+ wei loss. Gas cost amplifies the loss. No profitable extraction path from rounding.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - rounding direction analysis of all three pool types confirms protocol-favorable rounding

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Diamond proxy storage-slot collision across modules
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All modules share single LBAMMStorage at slot 0x9A1D via LBAMMStorage.sol. Pool types use their own globalState[msg.sender] mappings keyed by AMM address, preventing cross-type interference. No arbitrary storage writes. Transient storage uses fixed DIAMOND_STORAGE_QUEUED_FEE_COLLECT constant.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - LBAMMStorage.sol uses deterministic slot, pool types use msg.sender-keyed mappings

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Pool reserve vs actual balance desync
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Balance verification at AMMModule.sol:2207-2210 ensures exact token arrival. Reserve accounting at L1435-1442 is always <= net tokens received. Protocol fees stored separately. Failed LP distributions stored as tokensOwed (L1300), not lost. The invariant contractBalance >= reserves + feeBalances + protocolFees + tokensOwed is maintained by construction.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - balance check enforcement at _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse prevents any desync

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fee calculation asymmetry between input and output swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Input swap: protocol fee uses mulDiv (rounds down, L187). Output swap: protocol fee uses mulDivRoundingUp (rounds up, L222). This asymmetry exists but is not exploitable for insolvency — in both cases total_collected >= total_obligations. The rounding difference is 1 wei max per operation and favors protocol in output swaps.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: N/A - FeeHelper.sol L187 vs L222 show rounding difference but total conservation holds in both paths
